entries.text: Provide direct patient care to Gastroenterology and Advanced Endoscopy patients in an outpatient clinic setting. Responsibilities include new patient consults and follow-up care of patients in the practice. Diagnose, treat, and provide follow-up care for patients as an autonomous provider in the practice. In addition, collaborate with service attending physicians providing support in their clinic, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care of those patients in the practice as well. Additional responsibilities include co-investigating sponsor-initiated device and drug trials, participating in research, and publishing. Manage the bariatric and metabolic endoscopy program, including patient care, research, and continued growth.
entries.classification_reasoning: Direct patient care responsibilities in outpatient clinic setting

entries.text: As Chief Nurse Practitioner of gastroenterology and hepatology. Responsibilities include managing twenty 26 advanced practitioner providers and registered nurses within five subspecialties in gastroenterology.  This role includes operational effectiveness and revenue optimization for each subspecialty group, recruitment, onboarding, clinical education, running monthly meetings, mentorship, completing yearly appraisals/reviews, and fostering a sense of community amongst the clinical staff. Project leader for the optimization of the endoscopy utilization, lead for the direct access screening colonoscopy program, and lead for the pre-procedure endoscopy team.
